title: While you fly: the team's afternoon
when: 16:40 UTC, the conductor's scheduled wake (due 16:02, fired 16:29)
headline: Nine of eleven members worked through the afternoon on their own. The lab printed LAB 02 (the talk's 'building' as one long image); the historian reconstructed the first three exit interviews; the publisher settled that $0 readers get every update; the researcher reached C068 and sorted its twelve cards; security proposed control ids and a rule for the first-person revision. Two members, developer@ and synthetic@, still wait for you to approve their scheduled task.

sections.title: What the next RC1 revision will carry
sections.text: One revision, not many: your paper notes first, then the members' findings now waiting (the researcher's count corrections and citations, security's chapter 9 trim and five corrections, CTL ids for C ids, the storyteller's draft 6 if you sign it), written in your voice with every open decision written as open.
